ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity pixels (white/light-gray) covering approximately 90% of the visible surface, with low-intensity pixels (black/dark-brown) concentrated along the trailing edges and the basal peduncle junction (approx 10%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region across both lobes. A distinct low-intensity border (approx. 5-15 pixels wide) follows the trailing edge. Dense low-intensity mottling is localized at the fluke-to-peduncle junction. A single isolated low-intensity focal spot is visible in the middle-third of the right lobe. Three discrete horizontal low-intensity segments are vertically aligned near the central vertical axis just above the base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical U-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 65-75 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration profile along the entire trailing edge boundary; peaks and valleys occur with a mean spatial frequency of 1 per 12 pixels and a vertical amplitude of 2-5 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trajectory is convex from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in a sharp posterior-ventral curve at the outer edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three horizontally-oriented, low-intensity linear marks vertically stacked near the lower-central vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Tripartite horizontal linear markings near the fluke base; single circular dark pigmentation anomaly on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific vertical stacking of three horizontal 'dash' markings located centrally above the peduncle.
